title: Workflow labels helper
summary: A shared helper turns stored workflow values into Title Case labels, starting with dashboard attention items.
changes: Add one shared helper that shows workflow statuses, priorities and related values as Title Case labels, with a readable fallback for unknown values.
Dashboard attention items use the shared labels, so a waiting case now reads Waiting on User.
Document how screens should show workflow labels.
version_rationale: Patch on the 0.43 line: a shared display helper with no data or permission change.
validation: WorkflowLabelsTest covers lang-backed labels, fallbacks, option order and every label group.
composer pre-merge on the pull request branch.
known_limitations: Tickets, Cases, Consultations, Recruitment and Pet Profiles screens move to the shared labels in the following 0.43 releases.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. No database change is involved.
